what_this_is: Every integer or percentage in old-docs/**/*.md that looks like a count of something in this repository, compared against raw/repo_facts.json, which takes each count from the live object or the authoritative source rather than from a text pattern.
generated_by: experiments/product/independent-acceptance/repo_facts.py plus the manual sweep recorded here
volatility_warning: The repository changed WHILE this audit ran: between two runs 20 minutes apart, tests/ gained files and aries/ gained lines (test functions 776 -> 783, aries/ lines 40289 -> 40324, repo-wide .py files 455 -> 458). Every line-count and file-count verdict below is therefore true as of the snapshot above and will drift. This is itself the finding: a hand-written count of a live tree is wrong the moment it is written, which is why repo_facts.py exists.

verdict_legend.MATCHES: the claimed value equals the value taken from the live object or authoritative source
verdict_legend.WRONG: the claimed value differs from the authoritative value
verdict_legend.NOT_A_REPO_COUNT: the number is not a static count of the repository (an experiment result, a runtime measurement, a per-run test-execution count, a forward-looking plan, or a regex false positive)
